author: Shadowbladz
body:
Kicked for: "Racism"

So I was playing with a friend Kim_Jong_Hwi

He makes a sentence in chat and I respond with "this ain't North Korea" (could be paraphrasing, can't remember the exact setence. But it was in around 2am GMT May 3rd if you wanna check logs :) ).

So I get kicked for racism. I ask Porky why and he quotes "this ain't North Korea".

I ask how is that racist as I'm not actually saying North Koreans are worse than others or that I'm better because of my race

Ensue cat and mouse game of me trying to get a reason out of MLGPorky

Eventually I get "your kick was fair" and he leaves ¯\_(ツ)_/¯


Either teach people the definition of "racism" or don't kick for anything said in chat

I was also really disappointed with Porky's mechanical and unhelpful approach to explaining to me why I was kicked

TL;DR: Make joke in chat to friend, mod doesn't understand what racism means and get kicked.

Chat logs should be between 2am-2:10am GMT on May 3rd if you wanna check those :)

replies.body:
Hello,

It seems that you were incorrectly punished, and the staff member wasn't helpful either,  it was a rather unprofessional approach to the situation. I will appeal your infraction, and sorry for the long wait.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
